min-chars.tooltip: A one or two letter query, retyped into another layout, matches almost everything. Raise this if the menu feels noisy.

max-results.tooltip: How many wrong-layout matches to add. Results found in the layout you actually typed in are never limited.

skip-when-native-matches.description: Only search other layouts when the menu found nothing
skip-when-native-matches.tooltip: Keeps the list short, at the cost of hiding a wrong-layout match whenever the query also happens to match something in the current layout.

match-description.tooltip: Descriptions are long, so they match more loosely than names do.

match-desktop-id.tooltip: Matches names like dev.vencord.Vesktop.desktop, which is often what a launcher is really called.
